request: What did CRS report about Medicare prescription drug price negotiation and its expected savings?

reply.reply:
CRS’s December 2023 report said CBO projected Medicare drug-price negotiation would reduce federal Medicare drug spending by **$25 billion in 2031**. CBO also forecast selected drugs’ net prices would fall about **50% on average**, with average Part D net prices **9% lower** and Part B prices **8% lower** in 2031. These are federal spending and price estimates—not a quantified estimate of beneficiaries’ out-of-pocket savings in the pages checked. (CRS R47872, PDF p. 15; printed p. 12)

[See the brief](output/briefs/case-20261025-185738-4877.html).
reply.reasoning: Answered from the verified CRS findings. The source is dated December 2023, and the caveat limits the beneficiary-savings statement to pages checked.
